name: chainedr_holdout_v1
description: Held-out micro-corpus for evaluating ChainEDR generalisation. Samples were authored after the labelled training corpus was frozen and were not used to tune detector regexes, modifier sets, inline-auth patterns, alias-flow rules, or any other detector logic.
policy: Each sample has one or zero expected rule fires. False positives outside the expected_rule are recorded but do not count against recall.

samples.rationale: onlyOwner modifier gates the function; tx.origin == msg.sender is defence-in-depth on an access-controlled surface. AA7702-001 should NOT fire after modifier-aware suppression.
Unguarded public function gates on tx.origin == msg.sender. Classic flash-loan guard broken by 7702.
Aliased equivalent of tx.origin == msg.sender via local variables. Intra-function alias-flow pass must catch this.
tx.origin stored in state by one function, compared against msg.sender in another. Cross-function state-flow pass must catch this.
require(msg.sender == owner) inline auth check makes the function effectively gated. Inline-auth suppression must keep AA7702-001 silent.
code.length == 0 check on an unguarded public function; airdrop / receive-hook anti-pattern broken under 7702.
code.length check inside an onlyRole-gated function. Modifier-aware suppression must keep AA7702-002 silent.
Pure utility library with no auth and no 7702-relevant patterns. Nothing should fire.
Delegation-target shape with an unguarded delegatecall. AA7702-006 should fire.
ERC-20 permit without delegation-aware check. AA7702-010 should fire.
UUPS-style upgrade gated by onlyOwner; ERC-1967 proxy slot read is the standard upgrade mechanic. AA7702-009 must NOT fire.
Initializer with no init-flag guard; under 7702 any third party can re-point owner on a fresh EOA storage context.
Authorization digest binds chain_id = 0 explicitly; cross-chain replay enabled.
EIP-712 domain separator binds block.chainid; cross-chain replay structurally prevented. AA7702-004 must NOT fire.
ERC-7201 namespaced storage layout. AA7702-007 / AA7702-020 must NOT fire.
SmartAccount delegation target with raw, non-namespaced storage. Redelegation collides with next target's layout.
Delegation target contains selfdestruct path — executes in delegated EOA context, clears the EOA.
Hardcoded single relayer with no fallback — single point of failure for account liveness.
Multi-relayer set with owner-managed add/remove; account remains usable if any relayer is reachable.
EntryPoint v0.6 hardcoded; breaks for users on v0.7+.
ETH send to owner from an onlyOwner function; self-harm scenario, suppressed by access-gating in AA7702-003.
User-supplied recipient with isContract check; broken under EIP-7702 (delegated EOA has nonzero code.length).
Pure interface; cannot hold a runtime vuln. _is_interface_file must keep every detector silent.
Inline governance auth check; the tx.origin defence-in-depth comparison sits in a gated function. Inline-auth suppression must keep AA7702-001 silent.
Contract that inherits Ownable and uses onlyOwner throughout. No 7702-relevant patterns; nothing should fire.
